lede: Kansas State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +3.1 against -0.6, a 3.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Cincinnati +3.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Kansas State winning 60% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offensive line, where Cincinnati leads Kansas State by 93 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
